with.definition: Form of withe (alternative): A flexible, slender shoot or twig, especially when used as a band or for binding; a withy.

withal.definition: Together with the rest; besides; in addition.

withdrawn.definition: Form of withdraw (participle past): To draw or pull (something) away or back from its original position or situation.

withdraws.definition: Form of withdraw (indicative present singular third-person): To draw or pull (something) away or back from its original position or situation.

withereth.definition: Form of wither (archaic indicative present singular third-person): To shrivel, droop or dry up, especially from lack of water.

within.definition: In or into the interior; inside.

witness.definition: Attestation of a fact or event; testimony.

witnessed.definition: Form of witness (participle past): To furnish proof of, to show.

witnesses.definition: Form of witness (plural): Attestation of a fact or event; testimony.

witnessing.definition: Form of witness (gerund participle present): To furnish proof of, to show.

witted.definition: Form of wit (participle past): To know, be aware of (constructed with of when used intransitively).

wives.definition: Form of wife (plural): A married woman, especially in relation to her spouse.

wobegone.definition: Form of woebegone (archaic): Of a person: deeply affected or overwhelmed by suffering or trouble, and so filled with woe (“great distress or sadness”); (loosely) forlorn, sad, unhappy.

woe.definition: Great sadness or distress; a misfortune causing such sadness.

womanhood.definition: The state or condition of being a woman.

women.definition: Form of woman (plural): An adult female human.

wonder.definition: A sense of awe, astonishment and curiosity, inspired by unexpected events, novel experiences and inexplicable circumstances, sometimes accompanied by surprise, shock or reverence.

wondered.definition: Form of wonder (participle past): To be affected with surprise or admiration; to be struck with astonishment; to be amazed; to marvel; often followed by at.

wonderful.definition: Tending to excite wonder; surprising, extraordinary.

wondering.definition: Form of wonder (gerund participle present): To be affected with surprise or admiration; to be struck with astonishment; to be amazed; to marvel; often followed by at.

wont.definition: One's habitual way of doing things; custom, habit, practice.

won’t.definition: Will not (negative auxiliary); used to indicate a future non-occurring action.

wood.definition: The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

woodpile.definition: A pile of cut wood to be used as fuel.

woods.definition: Form of wood (plural): The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

woolly-heads.definition: Form of woolly-head (plural): A woolly-headed person, particularly (potentially offensive) a black or Arab person with Afro-textured hair.

word.definition: The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

words.definition: Form of word (plural): The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

wore.definition: Form of wear (past): To have on.

work.definition: To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

workbench.definition: A sturdy bench or table at which manual work is done by a carpenter, machinist, etc.

worked.definition: Form of work (participle past): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

working.definition: Form of work (gerund participle present): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

works.definition: Form of work (indicative present singular third-person): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

world.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

world-renowned.definition: Of worldwide renown; known and respected internationally.

worm.definition: A generally tubular invertebrate of the annelid phylum; an earthworm.

worms.definition: Form of worm (plural): A generally tubular invertebrate of the annelid phylum; an earthworm.

worn.definition: Form of wear (participle past): To have on.

worry.definition: To be troubled; to give way to mental anxiety or doubt.

worse.definition: Form of bad (comparative): Of low quality.

worshiped.definition: Form of worship (US participle past): To reverence (a deity, etc.) with supreme respect and veneration; to perform religious exercises in honour of.

worst.definition: Superlative form of bad: most bad.

worthless.definition: Having no worth or use; without value.

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

wound.definition: Form of wind (participle past): To blow air through a wind instrument or horn to make a sound.

wounded.definition: Form of wound (participle past): To hurt or injure (someone) by cutting, piercing, or tearing the skin.

wounds.definition: Form of wound (plural): An injury, such as a cut, stab, or tear, to a (usually external) part of the body.

wrapped.definition: Form of wrap (participle past): To enclose (an object) completely in any flexible, thin material such as fabric or paper.

wrapping.definition: Form of wrap (gerund participle present): To enclose (an object) completely in any flexible, thin material such as fabric or paper.

wrath.definition: Great anger; (countable) an instance of this.

wrathful.definition: Possessed of great wrath; very angry.

wreak.definition: To cause harm; to afflict; to inflict; to harm or injure; to let out harm.

wretch.definition: An unhappy, unfortunate, or miserable person.

wretchedness.definition: An unhappy state of mental or physical suffering.

wriggling.definition: Form of wriggle (gerund participle present): To twist one's body to and fro with short, writhing motions; to squirm.

wringing.definition: Form of wring (gerund participle present): Often followed by out: to squeeze or twist (something moist) tightly so that liquid is forced out.

wrists.definition: Form of wrist (plural): The complex joint between forearm bones, carpus, and metacarpals where the hand is attached to the arm; the carpus in a narrow sense.

write.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writer.definition: A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writes.definition: Form of write (indicative present singular third-person): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writhed.definition: Form of writhe (participle past): To twist, wring (something).

writhing.definition: Form of writhe (gerund participle present): To twist, wring (something).

writing.definition: Form of write (gerund participle present): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

written.definition: Form of write (participle past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wronged.definition: Form of wrong (participle past): To treat unjustly; to injure or harm; to do wrong by.

wrongs.definition: Form of wrong (plural): Something that is immoral or not good.

wrote.definition: Form of write (past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

yankees.definition: Form of yankee (plural): A native or inhabitant of some part of the United States.

yard.definition: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yards.definition: Form of yard (plural): A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yarns.definition: Form of yarn (plural): A twisted strand of fibre used for knitting or weaving.

ye.definition: The Cyrillic letter Е, е, featured in various Slavic and Turkic languages.

year.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

year’s.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

yelled.definition: Form of yell (participle past): To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yelpings.definition: Form of yelping (plural): The act of producing a yelp.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yield.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielded.definition: Form of yield (participle past): To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielding.definition: Form of yield (gerund participle present): To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yields.definition: Form of yield (indicative present singular third-person): To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yo.definition: Form of yo (alternative): The name of the letter Ё/ё in Cyrillic alphabets.

yoke.definition: Form of yolk (misspelling): The yellow, spherical part of an egg that is surrounded by the white albumen, and serves as nutriment for the growing young.

yonder.definition: At or in a distant but indicated place.

york.definition: To bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

younger.definition: Form of young (comparative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

zeal.definition: The fervour or tireless devotion for a person, cause, or ideal and determination in its furtherance; diligent enthusiasm; powerful interest.

zealous.definition: Full of zeal; ardent, fervent; exhibiting enthusiasm or strong passion, particularly in matters of religion.
